| Command                     | Description                                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `strata acp`                | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server               |
| `strata mcp`                | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers            |
| `strata [project]`          | start strata tui                                       |
| `strata attach <url>`       | attach to a running strata server                      |
| `strata run [message..]`    | run strata with a message                              |
| `strata debug`              | debugging and troubleshooting tools                    |
| `strata auth`               | manage AI providers and credentials                    |
| `strata agent`              | manage agents                                          |
| `strata upgrade [target]`   | upgrade strata to the latest or a specific version     |
| `strata uninstall`          | uninstall strata and remove all related files          |
| `strata serve`              | starts a headless strata server                        |
| `strata models [provider]`  | list all available models                              |
| `strata stats`              | show token usage and cost statistics                   |
| `strata export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON                            |
| `strata import <file>`      | import session data from JSON file or URL              |
| `strata pr <number>`        | fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run strata |
| `strata session`            | manage sessions                                        |
| `strata remote`             | enable remote connection for real-time session relay   |
| `strata db`                 | database tools                                         |
| `strata config`             | configuration tools                                    |
| `strata plugin <module>`    | install plugin and update config                       |
